title: Empire Summit at The Grand Lodge | KEY.co
h1: Empire Summit at The Grand Lodge
description_expanded: Upstairs, a second primary suite mirrors the grandeur of its lower-level counterpart, offering sun-drenched mountain views, serene design, and a deep soaking tub that rivals any boutique spa. The upper level also hosts a spacious bunk room with four full-size beds, designed with comfort and style in mind—perfect for families or groups. Every room is curated with high-thread-count linens, upscale finishes, and thoughtful touches that elevate the guest experience. Whether gathering by the fire, retreating to private quarters, or taking in the views, this home is a sanctuary built for unforgettable moments in the mountains. The property's city and/or the HOAs have strict parking rules. No parking is allowed on the street year-round. The Guest acknowledges that the vehicles will get ticketed and/or towed for violating the city's and/or the HOA's parking rules and regulations. Any costs or damages resulting from such parking violations shall be the Guest's sole responsibility, and in no event shall the Property Management be held liable for any costs or damages resulting from the Guest, the Guest's visitors, or licensees parking in violation of Park City's and/or the HOA's parking rules, regulations, ordinances, or any other governing terms.
